bio: People have been flocking to Andrea and Harald Huber's Fischerwirt for years – and with good reason. This is hospitality at its finest. In the charming and elegant indoor area or out on the cosy little terrace, diners are attended to by a thoroughly affable team managed by your cordial hostess. And, of course, there is the delicious food – seasonal specialities from the region and traditional classics are served throughout the day. The extensive menu has something for everyone – from braised Borettana onion with crosne and charred leek to Backhenderl (breaded fried chicken) and Kalbsrahmbeuschel (veal lights ragout), every dish looks tempting.
